title: Notification regarding Single bench matters of Hon'ble The Chief Justice to be listed on 22-09-2026 will be taken up on the same day before Hon'ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 21;t September, 2026
No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/ : it is informed to all learned members of the Bar
and litigants that Single Bench matters of Hon’ble The Chief Justice to be listed on 22-09-
2026 will be taken up on the same day before the Single Bench of Hon’ble Mr. Justice A.
Birnol Singh for fixing dates, extension of interim orders as well as for taking up urgent
matters.
By Order etc.
Sd/-
(MONALISA MAIBAM)
REGISTRAR (JUDL.)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/1/96-BENCH/„,B3’gg - 603 Imphal, the 21st September, 2026
